text.en:
Republic Act No. 5864 entitled "An Act Creating the Municipality of Pitogo in the Province of
Bohol" is hereby amended by changing the name of the Municipality of Pitogo to "Municipality of President
Carlos P. Garcia."

Henceforth, Municipality of Pitogo, Province of Bohol shall, as a political subdivision, be known
as "Municipality of President Carlos P. Garcia" and all transactions, documents, laws, decrees, court orders, or
decisions, ordinances, resolutions, and all other papers bearing the name of Pitogo, Bohol, shall be understood
to mean "Municipality of Carlos P. Garcia."

All laws, decrees, proclamations, executive orders and ordinances inconsistent with this Decree
are hereby modified, amended or repealed accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect one month after its publication in the Official Gazette.
Done in the City of Manila, Philippines this 27th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred
and seventy-seven.
